title: Bermuda bar: a stranger's birthday unlocks a woman's phone

tellings.quote: So I said, "Um, put in your birthday." And he puts in his birthday and the phone opens.

plain: In a bar in Bermuda, a stranger typed his own birthday into a woman's locked phone and it opened, according to the magician and YouTuber Chris Ramsay, who was there. Ramsay says it was he who told the man, "put in your birthday," and he tells it as one of the strange coincidences that make him think something more is going on.
